branchRule: Per eligible user, skills ordered by first date; every skill on the next distinct date is an immediate successor of every skill on the current date; same-day ties never counted; the cohort rule is applied to each (from, to) transition
caveat: Stack Overflow question order (first question per tag), users who started after both technologies existed; asking ≠ completing
cohortRule: For pair (A,B) count only users whose first-ever question is >= 12 months after both technologies existed (birth = first appearance of any of the skill's tags on the site); same-day ties dropped; users with 2-40 mapped skills only
licence: Stack Overflow content is CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://stackoverflow.com/help/licensing); aggregate counts only

samples.sede-current: Stack Exchange Data Explorer, current data: users with >= 1 LLM-era question among posts with Id >= 73000000, OwnerUserId % 1 = 0 (100 % of users), full history per user; pairs with an LLM-era endpoint only

shrinkage: shareShrunk = (n + alpha * prior) / (nTotal + alpha), uniform prior 1/nNextObserved over the observed next-skills; shares sum to 1 over all observed successors, the listed subset (n >= branchMinListed) sums to less
